Officer's narrative
On a clear afternoon in Katy, Texas, Driver 1 was changing lanes when the front quarter of the vehicle contacted the
rear quarter panel of Driver 2's vehicle, causing a sideswipe. Both vehicles were drivable and remained at the scene.
Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy. Officres reviewed secne photographs, which confirm the position
of both vehicles and the general area of contact. The damage to both vehicles is consistent with the impact described
by the drivers. Some older scratches appear on the affected panel, and it is not certain whteher they predate this
collision. No independent witnesses were located. Driver 2 and the respnoding officer both state that the Passneger
was not inside the vehicle when the collision occurred. The Passenger later reported a wrist fracture. The impact
appeared minor at the scene, and no airbag deployment was reported. Further medical records and statements will
be needed to evaluate the reported injury.
